title: Father with Baby in Sun Hat, Grassy Backyard - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: An intimate black-and-white family snapshot captured on August 2, 1932, during the Great Depression. A smiling young man in a rolled-sleeve collared shirt and dark trousers kneels in a grassy field or backyard, gently steadying an infant seated before him in white clothes and a sun hat. In the background across tall wild grass stand houses and outbuildings under a clear summer sky.
